changes: Introduced the xc_fanout daemon as the new live streaming delivery layer
Migrated live HLS and TS delivery from the legacy PHP proxy path to the daemon
Added daemon-based encrypted HLS delivery and in-memory segmenting
Added automatic xc_fanout installation, updates, supervision and self-healing
Added automatic re-feed of streams after daemon restarts
Added disconnect accounting, off-air detection and viewer divergence telemetry
Added LB-to-MAIN Redis support and xcvm_core self-update
Improved Load Balancer installation, provisioning and binary management
Moved the Ministra/Stalker portal from a module into core and updated it to Ministra 5.6.10
Added automatic daily yt-dlp updates through cron:root_signals
Replaced PHP-CS-Fixer with PHP_CodeSniffer and Slevomat Coding Standard
Improved Redis health checks, recovery, watchdog behavior and connection resilience
Fixed database connection overflow and improved database lifecycle handling
Improved streaming stability during Redis failures, cold caches and daemon restarts
Fixed MPEG-TS segmentation with LLOD v2 and On Demand streams
Fixed symlink processing on Load Balancer servers
Improved null-safety and error handling across the application
Improved stream and database diagnostics and client log reporting
Added automatic GeoIP database recovery
Migrated documentation to MkDocs Material with generated Russian translations
Added extensive documentation for the new streaming daemon architecture
Removed legacy streaming proxy code and other obsolete components
Improved CI/CD workflows, release automation and development tooling
